MISSION THE PICKET LINE
SITUATION OPAREA: K-525 patrol box. ASW pickets and helicopter patterns are establishing a barrier.
MISSION Map K-525's ASW pickets, then withdraw.
EXECUTION Map the picket line and helicopter patterns around K-525, then withdraw with the contact picture.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT No weapons release unless required for self-defense. Preserve the intelligence picture.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. USS Drum is assigned; its loss does not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
